title: Grokking in LLM Pretraining? Monitor Memorization-to-Generalization without Test
reasoning: The paper is a technical research study on the 'grokking' phenomenon (delayed generalization) in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models. It introduces new metrics to monitor generalization during pretraining and evaluates them against standard performance benchmarks in domains like math, code, and commonsense reasoning. It does not contain any evaluation or component related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
